The general idea of constructing measure is, in crude terms:
Find a collection of set that has a clear notion of size
Make the collection closed in finite set operations by generating an algebra on the collection.
Approximate arbitrary subsets using element in the algebra, hence get a notion of size on arbtirary subsets
Make the notion of size truely a measure by restricting to a special collection of subset.
